assessment_states.note: Counts over the development collection only. Not a success rate for any sponsor, drug or the cohort.

audit_eligible.definition: Eligible trials in the development (audit) collection.

eligible.definition: Eligible trials in the beta cohort.

frame.definition: Records matched by the frame query.

metrics.definition: A results section is posted on ClinicalTrials.gov as of the cutoff.
metrics.label: Results posted

metrics.definition: No results posted and more than one year since actual primary completion (and any certified delay). Not a finding of non-compliance: applicable-trial status and extensions are not established.
metrics.label: No posted results, past the standard one-year window

metrics.definition: No results posted; less than one year since actual primary completion, or within two years of a certification of delay.
metrics.label: No posted results, within the standard window

metrics.definition: No results posted; the registry gives an estimated primary completion date or an unknown status.
metrics.label: No posted results, completion not confirmed

metrics.definition: Withdrawn, or terminated with an actual enrolment of zero.
metrics.label: No posted results, no participants

metrics.definition: A protocol document is posted on the registry. Availability only: not whether it states a usable rule.
metrics.label: Protocol posted

metrics.definition: A SAP document is posted on the registry. Availability only: not whether it states a usable rule.
metrics.label: Statistical analysis plan posted

metrics.definition: At least one of the two is posted.
metrics.label: Protocol or SAP posted

metrics.definition: Audit-collection trials whose assessment a named person has reviewed.
metrics.label: Assessments reviewed by a person

metrics.definition: The trial appears in the site's participant-demographics dataset.
metrics.label: In the participant-demographics dataset
